notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27349817/c7f423dda20e392028241d80f93e2be5ac2c4005.png

Thanks everyone for the patience on this update. We know it's taking more time than previously expected but we're still committed to delivering a finish product. A special thanks to everyone who helped out while in the beta version.

Release Notes

Map
- Expanded to New Area includes Mangrove Swamp/Volcanic/Desert/Ocean biomes with new points of interest areas.
- The "final map area" is fairly complete as well but it's currently not accessible in this release.
- General map improvements to textures, rocks, particles and vegetation.
- Improvement to existing map areas.
- New vegetation bending system.

Audio
- Players voice added with 50+ quips
- Point of Interest discovery music added
- New Ambiance Sounds
- New AI Sound Effects

Herds 
- Support for all herbivores. 
- Includes size variations. 
- Herds(except for Brach) can go almost anywhere.

New AI Models/Textures for:
- TRex
- Brachiosaurus
- Parasaur

Many AI Fixes and Improvements, a few include:
- Spinosaur hunting/eating fish
- Brachiosaurus stomp
- AI now have physics colliders(for example Brachiosaurus legs will collide with player)
- Bioscanner now picks up small creatures

Controller Support Expanded
- Inventory is now usable with left analog stick

New Creatures
- Archaeopteryx
- Limulus(horseshoe crab)
- Several bird species
- Coelacanth(fish)
- Electric Eel(these were fish previously)

Tweaks
- Decreased illness chances and increase flower spawning(should make dealing with illness easier)
- Fatigue capacity reduces over time. It can be increased by sleeping or using a stimpack.
- Spears aren't destroyed when hitting dirt material
- Thirst decreased more rapidly when in desert and lava areas
- New footstep sounds and effects

Items & Gear
- Power Overloader(uses suits power to shock nearby enemies)
- Plasma Core(throwable breakable item which disperses and radiates AI)
- Water Bottle(single use)
- Antibiotics(cures all illness)
- Powerbar
- Fruit(these regenerate - part of a tree/bush)
- Wooden Mask(reduces AI awareness) - Use with Right Mouse Button, couching also helps

Many other bugfixes including things related to:
- Bioscanner(would stop working after certain amount of time)
- Backpacks(drop bug after saving small back pack)
- Small creatures like frog and turtle can be picked up properly in hand
- Crash after loading and then bringing up inventory
- Ladders (Fixed slipping off, camera control, new model and other issues)
- Multiple of same item added to inventory
- Unable to drop gear or weapon

notes.title: v.11 Update News
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Earlier this year we decided to try and finish off the story/main missions with this next update. We’re making good progress but it’s taking longer than expected to implement it, along with other additions and the map expansion. 

Therefore, we’ve decided to shift gears a bit and wrap up some things we’ve been working on that are standalone (not directly connected to the story) and are close to completion. By doing this it should allow us to get a new release out in February.

One drawback to releasing like this is that our old missions will not be included since they are still undergoing a lot of changes. This means it will be sandbox only this time.

Many of the things we discussed and showed off before will be included. A new very large area of the map will be available (larger than the last expansion) but not the entire final size quite yet. You’ll hear some music, player quips and many other new sounds. New small creatures, TRex redesign, items/gear and herding for all herbivores should all make it in. The update will also include tons of bug fixes, AI improvements, stamina system changes, expanded controller support and more.

Thanks again for your patience on this release.

notes.title: Update News
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

We wanted to give you an update and let you know where things are headed with the game.

First off, for a number of reasons we’ve decided to hold off on our previously planned spring release.

We know this will be disappointing to some but the game is going through a lot of changes and it just doesn’t make sense from a development or game-play perspective for a release right now.

With that said, the map expansion is coming along well. We’ve also begun to shift our focus to the final story/missions. We’re implementing a custom sound/music system now and moving toward finishing the script, complete with voice acting.

And of course we’re always working on adding new creatures and other content.

Progress is slow but steady, we’ve still got a ways to go but we’ll be able to get a release out later this year that is a lot closer to the final version of the game. We'll keep you posted with more details and screenshots as things progress.

notes.title: v0.1 Released!
notes.content:
v0.1 Release Notes

- Playable Map Size has doubled!
- New Dino Parasaur(Parasaurolophus)
- New grasslands/plains area.
- Prisoner Encampments with Dedicated Traders
- AI Herding System - first iteration, will expand use in future for other herbivores
- Snare Craftable - snares can be placed on tree limbs that stick out. Can currently catch humans, utahraptors, leaelly,, baby raptors, compys.
- Explosive Tripwire Craftable
- 8 new pod locations in new area and 2 new crash sites and a new cave with a cinematic sequence, other hidden secret areas.
- Active Volcanic Eruptions
- New MedPack item for 25% health boost. New Winch and Sensor items.
- Fast Travel - this is done from the map screen by selecting the home/shelter icon(during travel time passes based on distance and thirst, hunger, stamina won't be decremented) Can't fast travel if hostile AI nearby.
- New Player hit reactions
- New Stats and Achievements and UI Paging
- Large number of tweaks and fixes. Containers usable underwater, decrease chances of illness from biting. Fix for a lighting system crash. Ammo is now picked up in hand like other items. Various AI improvements. Selectable POIs, Objectives, and Shelter icons in map screen. New starting pod location and some minor mission changes. Inventory Menu Improvements - gradients & transparency, Player shadow fixes, New Terrain Textures, Herbivore eating anims/ai, decals, many new particle effects, etc.


Notes: 
- Since the game map will be changing so much soon the in game map will be updated in a later release once the map is closer to full completion.
- The new area is still a work in progress so things could change a bit in the future. If you happen to see some weird things like floating rocks or anything strange just snag a screenshot and share in steam and we'll get it fixed.
- No new missions were added, the first and second missions have just been moved to the new area to encourage exploration. It's also possible to complete the third mission(find comm device) in new area as well.

notes.title: v0.09 Released!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/2e46174ca8c4eb2d60c5add986573379ae040d3b.png

Hey Everyone,

This release took longer than expected and isn’t quite a large as some in the past, we apologize. We’ve had to take on some additional outside work which has slowed development down. On top of that we also encountered a few setbacks including a hardware failure.

It’s true progress has been slower but we’re as excited and motivated as ever to continue development but at this time we’ll need to do it at a pace that can prevent burnout and allows us to keep moving forward. Circumstances may change in the future that permit us to speed up development time again but as of right now this is the only way we can envision a sustainable path to long term success.

You, the community have been amazing over the last several years and we hope you’ll understand and stay onboard for the journey, even if it’s a longer one than first anticipated.

On the horizon, map expansion is currently underway but could not make it into this update. Several other new items are still in progress and will be featured in v0.1, like a new buildable as well as Prisoner encampments among other things.

This release should be the most stable and bug free version yet. Let us know if you’re still seeing any issues, big or small.

Release Notes:

 Spinosaurus
Steam Stats & Achievements System(initial version)
Increased variety of Prisoner models
Improved Actor & Item Spawner(should provide a more consistent experience)
Fixes for two most common crashes that remained(all crashes are fixed that we are aware of) -  This includes the level saving/loading corruption fix. If you are still getting crashing/freezing please let us know. 
AI Improvements/Enhancements
Optimizations(esp for those Medium settings) - a variety of different optimizations in order to support a larger map area
Lighting Improvements
20+ Bug Fixes & many other tweaks


As usual, you’ll need to start a new game once updated.

notes.title: v0.08 Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/92ade4695f4eb73750eadc6ee80eb09f7f3f46a9.png

Hey Everyone,

Thanks again for hanging in there. This release took a bit longer than we'd planned but we were able to pack in a lot more new content and features than the typical release. We think you'll really enjoy the updates in v0.08. 

Some of the things in this release:

    New Large Wreckage Area
    New Alligator AI
    AI Recruitment System
    Several New Missions("Wreck Access" and "Restore Power", at the end of the previous missions)
    Next Iteration of Map System

    Waypoint Ability Added(Right Mouse Click)
    Drag and Drop(Left Mouse Hold) to move map around
    Added Discovered Points of Interests(POIs) to Map

    Hunger System - meat, Utahraptor eggs, mushrooms, flowers(small amount) can provide nourishment, more in the future
    New Gear

    Canteen, allows for increased water capacity.
    Boots, allows for more agile movement.
    Thermal Boots, agile movement + ability to withstand high temperatures.

    Expanded spawning system to spawn smaller creatures dynamically(bats, salamanders and more)
    New Crate Containers(replaces old ones)

    The items they contain are semi-dynamic so each play-through will have some variability of items.

    New T-Rex Carcass
    Onscreen HUD updates with hotkey, illness and keycard display(defaulted to on now)
    Lighting/Shadow and Flashlight Adjustments
    Various Performance Improvements, Bug Fixes and Adjustments. Some users may notice significant improvements.


You'll have to start a New Game with this update and as always we'd appreciate your feedback on everything. Thanks Everyone!

notes.title: v0.06 Patch
notes.content:
v0.06 Patch

Fix for a text rendering crash
AI fixes for Utahraptor and Ceratosaurus staring without attacking while shooting
Fix for trade failures & craft failures involving new items
Fix for PDA Screen not appearing after save/load
New notification message when trying to craft weapon when weapon inventory full
Fixed TRex AI to allow pick up and carry/eat of human NPCs
Added missing Solar Cell texture
Fix for water color/brightness
Other misc fixes and adjustments


Unfortunately with with patch you'll lose your game save. We try our best not to do this with a patch but in this case we had to, sorry about that. Be sure to turn off auto-update in Steam if you don't want to start things over.

Also, thanks for the feedback, videos and logs. They helped us track down several items on this list.

notes.title: v0.05 Release! (Updated)
notes.content:
***A patch for rain issues has been applied.  Please update.***

Hey everyone, v0.05 is here!

This release includes:

Xenoceratops

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/58ef14ce015fedac0071d0f446c7face9cd59f13.png

First iteration of the Weather System(rain, puddling, lightning, thunder) 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/8f26188934e8d6157320ac52fb08219274e09df9.png

Known bugs: Right click zooming can be can blurry for some or result in a black screen. Rain will go through escape pods/crashsites. Because of these issues we provided a way for the rain to be disable. 

Simply add:

weatherEffectsEnabled = 0 

to Steam/steamapps/common/CollisionCourse/system.cfg

- Improved multiple days(Morning Rain, Overcast, Evening Rain, etc)
- Many bug fixes including(two potential crashes, a stuttering issue, footstep sound improvements, rending issue causing slight flickering and other performance tweaks)

The easiest way to check out the different days is to sleep. When sleeping it will now take you to a new day. To sleep you'll need to build a shelter with thermal shielding. The easiest place to find it is probably at the base of a dead tree hanging out over the pod near the lower crashsite but there are other places of course.

As always you'll need to start a new game. Let us know how you like the update or if you find any new issues. Also, thanks everyone for taking the poll. Your feedback is directly shaping future releases!

Have a safe and happy holiday weekend!(for those in U.S and Canada at least :) )

notes.title: v0.04 Patch Released!
notes.content:
Steam summer sale is coming up!  If you've been waiting for a time to buy, that would be a great time.  We cant do it without your support.  We'll have a status update and news to come.

Thanks for the support!

Here's the release notes for this patch. We've added a bit more changes than a typical patch so let us know how you like the new additions.

- added new craftable electric grenade weapon
- added new 24 hour lighting cycle with improved HDR and night time
- added new notification system for picking up items, disease, and crafting
- added new item spawning system, spawning will be more consistent now throughout the map
- added new particle spawning system including fireflies at night
- fix for water on screen effect and other numerous bug fixes, tweaks and small additions

Some shots of the new additions:

New Time of Day Cycle
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/b8bfb68166a23a8113ee0fec8b9244319127aabf.png

New Notification System and Fireflies
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/5df43471b31838c1d8a6e4d0de958dbe4cc21770.png

As always you will need to start a new game after this update.

notes.title: v0.04 Released!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/30f7c046e022316db32e748eb58d5ccf5d07521a.png

Thanks everyone for their feedback/screenshots, they've helped tremendously. Unfortunately the Xenoceratops could not make it in this release. We had to make a tough decision to push it back to v0.05, sorry about that. Here's a list of the main things added in v0.04:

- 3 illness types(Listeria, Sepsis, and Dysentery) with various onscreen and vital effects, craftable cures and flower items
- new interactable escape pods
- drag and drop item reordering
- hot key use/grab 1-4 keys (up,right,down,left of d-pad for xbox controllers)
- spears are now managed as normal weapons in inventory
- weapons have dedicated ammo bars
- improved TRex AI attack behavior and other general AI enhancements
- improve dinosaur textures
- new fire and shelter crafting tutorial missions
- new sounds for a variety of things
- new terrain textures
- 50+ bug fixes and tweaks

Remember to start a new game, your previously saves will not work with this update. As always, let us know how you like the new update and things we can fix/improve upon.

notes.title: v0.03 Patch
notes.content:
We've identified the main cause of the crashing in v0.03 and are working towards a fix now. We'll be putting out a patch as soon as possible to address this as well as many other issues we've been seeing from your feedback. 

In the mean time, to prevent the crash avoid saving or loading the game after building a fire.

Thanks everyone

notes.title: v0.03 Release
notes.content:
Thanks for hanging in there everyone, it took a bit longer than anticipated. Our main focus this release was to get some of the survival/crafting elements in place to build upon in the future. As always we're looking forward to getting your feedback and helping us to identify bugs and/or annoyances. Remember, this update will blow away your previous save state.  Enjoy the update everyone! 

For some directions on how to use some of the new features check out this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ITervHsU8rk

Important changes in this release:

First Iteration of Crafting System includes Campfires and Shelters(these will have more functionality in future releases - fast-travel, etc)

Directional Hit Reactions(example: TRex can get knocked back from Steg tail hit) with damage spots, Utahraptors will get knocked back by hits, etc.

Revamped Inventory UI with crafting, map, objectives, help screen

Containers System used in Corpses, Campfires, Shelters

Meat Harvesting from small creatures and dinosaurs

Meat Cooking on fire

New Cerat Anims

Improved Pistol Textures

Two new small AI, Leaellynasaura and Compsognathus

New hand gestures

New Engine Version(resolves audio bugs, graphical improvments)

Items now pickable underwater

New rock models and terrain textures

Many new sounds.

Many other bug fixes, tweaks and optimizations

notes.title: v0.02 Hotfix
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27349817/44bc9a8f44fe098c21916f0fed014b5cf6e972dd.png

Fix for Objective System and several other items.

NOTE: This update and any in the future (which alters the map) will remove your save file. Please don’t try to back it up then override it after updating. 

Eventually we’ll move the saving outside of the map. Also, anytime you verify your game files in Steam, it will also replace your save files and system.cfg so be sure to make a backup before verifying.

We added clouds in by default, they do have a flickering issue right now and can be disabled in the system.cfg by commenting out several params:

--r_VolumetricClouds = 1
--e_clouds = 1

Also if you are experiencing crashing or freezing try disabling the fog in system.cfg:

--e_volumetricfog = 1
